verdict.rationale: Codex CLI documents `codex --image` for passing a design reference, diagram, or screenshot with the prompt, or pasting an image into the composer. Codex can also reach design tools such as Figma through MCP, and as a local coding agent it can edit files and run tools. However, no evidence shows it turning a sketch or design into a working app end to end, and PDF input is never mentioned. Missing for 10: PDF design input, a documented design-to-working-app workflow, hands-on or independent corroboration of generating apps from sketches or images.
